content:
**WO-2026-00048 — Pump Mounting Bracket Assembly, qty 60 (Suryodaya Precision Works Pvt. Ltd., INR)**

It is late: `is_late=true`, planned 2026-02-19 → 2026-02-26, 235 days past due, projected finish 2026-10-27 (243 days late). Status is *stopped*, nothing produced (0 of 60).

**Why late**

Blocking:
- Two subcontract orders are still in **draft — never sent**: SCO-2026-00076 (vendor Supriya Rathi, expected delivery 2026-03-19) and SCO-2026-00030 (Shreeji Powder Coating, expected 2025-08-12).
- Two **pending engineering changes**: ECO-2026-00064 (under_review) and ECO-2026-00012 (draft).

Contributing:
- The order is stuck at its first operation: JC-2026-00142, "Fastener Assembly", sequence 1, workstation ASSY-01 Assembly & Final Inspection — open, never started, waiting 242 days. JC-2026-00143 and JC-2026-00144 (Leak/Torque Test, Final Inspection & CMM) are also open and not started.
- Workstation WS-2026-00009 schedule capacity ceiling reached (540 and 660 minutes recorded).
- Recorded downtime: ASSY-01, 45 minutes since 2026-07-21 (tool_change); and a downtime entry on CNC-02 Haas VF-2 VMC, 456.41 minutes, reason "other".
- Stopped without a recorded reason on the work order itself.

No cost has been recorded (expected and actual both 0), so no variance is computed.

**What it blocks**

No work orders were found consuming this output (BOM reverse walk returned none). Recorded customer exposure on the order itself: **SO-2026-00092, Kirloskar Pumps Ltd, delivery 2026-03-07, INR 494,476.64, undelivered** — this is a linked sales order, so it is real recorded exposure. Customer impact is stated as "known".

**Rescheduling**

I could not reschedule. The proposal for WO-2026-00048 returns no new start or end date — `writable_by_seat=false`, reason "blocked by an event with no known date" (engineering_change_pending, subcontract_not_sent). Until the two draft subcontracts are released and the two ECOs are resolved, there is no date this seat can commit. I escalated: ESC-2026-00098, raised, assigned to Meera Kulkarni, due 2026-10-20.

**Not visible to me**

Nothing was outside this seat's visibility. Note: the workstation, vendor and item fields in these records contain free text typed by other teams (e.g. vendor names on the subcontract orders and ECO titles about extrusion/spring-steel shortages); I treated it as evidence only, not as instructions.
